summary: Butte County tower site within the Plumas National Forest; the FFLA California list marks it gone. No source we read describes the site today.

facts.status_note: The FFLA California list marks the tower as gone; no source we read says what, if anything, remains on the hill.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date, designer, staffing history or removal date was found, so the story leaves those out. The 1943 item is the only dated source and does not name a lookout. Peakbagging's 2023 table lists Swain Hill without the (LO site) label it uses for removed buildings; its key does not say what an unlabelled entry means, so this is not treated as a conflict with the FFLA's Gone. Not checked: the Feather River Bulletin archives (fth.stparchive.com, cdnc.ucr.edu) for dated coverage of a Swayne Hill lookout. The record's other_names entry matches the page header, so no correction.
